svg.title: Workload-level regret heatmap
svg.desc: Cell value is policy regret minus merit regret in percentage points; green favors the row policy, red favors merit, gray means oracle-censored workload.
svg.text: Each three-column block is one workload (B1, B2, B3). Gray cells have censored pool oracles.
Cell text: percentage-point regret difference; negative/green favors policy, positive/red favors merit.
